name: Loftbarrage
description: Coil the whole body in a half spin so the arm whips the shaft round into the throw.

name: Torrent Thinheft
description: Roll the shaft over the shoulder to bat aside a blow aimed at the back of the neck.

name: Gust Whistle
description: Pivot on one heel through a full turn to leave the line of an attack.

name: Barbedthrash
description: Whirl the weighted butt around to strike a flank that the point cannot reach.

name: Lancing Dropdive
description: Spin the body and release with qi on the outer hand so the shaft curves around a raised shield.

name: Downpour Loft
description: Sweep the shaft round in a flat ring of qi that drives back everyone close.

name: Harpooning Whistle
description: Pour qi into a full-body spin and release so the shaft lands with the force of a heavy bolt.

name: Interlocking Dart
description: Link a whirling butt strike and a spinning point thrust and a final release into one unbroken turn.

name: Rumble Fletch
description: Hook the point under the top edge of a shield and lift to show the face behind it.

name: Verity Dartcap
description: Watch where the shields of a line overlap poorly and mark the weakest gap.

name: Needling Launch
description: Throw flat and hard from a few paces at the gap between two shields.

name: Launchcanter
description: Back off one pace after the throw so the line cannot close on the thrower.

name: Glint Skewerflight
description: Throw into the overlap of two shields with qi at the tip so that it splits them.

name: Fletchgreave
description: Catch the barb on a shield rim and pull with qi to drag the shield out of line.

name: Tearing Dart
description: Throw three shafts in turn at one spot until the line there gives way.

name: Tempered Dropdive
description: Compress qi in the point and throw so it bursts through a shield and the arm behind it.

name: Mayhem Thinheft
description: Lodge the shaft in a gap between shields and hold it with qi so friends can pour through.

name: Plumeremedy
description: Fix the eye on a distant mark and hold it through the whole of the draw.

name: Dartbarrage
description: Drive off the rear leg and extend the arm fully to throw as far as strength allows.

name: Skinning Loft
description: Release at a rising angle to land the shaft on a mark beyond a ridge.

name: Dartspurt
description: Lengthen the approach run so that more speed reaches the final cast.

name: Loftsprint
description: Catch the balance with a short roll after an all-out throw so no foe finds the thrower off line.

name: Leadassault
description: Keep a thread of qi on the shaft in flight so that it does not sag over a long reach.

name: Nova Launch
description: Combine the cord with a push of qi at release to send the shaft far past bare-handed range.

name: Perceptive Tailweight
description: Hold a thread of qi to the shaft in flight and steer it with small turns of the wrist.

name: Rupturing Dropdive
description: Charge the shaft with qi and cast it on a high arc to fall on a mark at the edge of sight.

name: Facet Skewerflight
description: Lob the shaft to its peak and send qi down it so the point plunges through a tent roof or an awning.

name: Discerning Fletch
description: Study an armoured man or a beast to find the joints and soft places where a point can enter.

name: Iron Whistle
description: Thrust upward into the soft belly of a rearing beast as it rises.

name: Leadcuirass
description: Set the butt of the shaft in the ground at the angle of a charging boar's shoulders.

name: Lambasting Launch
description: Throw a narrow point at a seam in the armour from no more than a few paces.

name: Surging Dartpoint
description: Slide aside at the last moment and let a horned beast's rush pass by the hip.

name: Chime Throwloop
description: Jam the shaft behind a plate or a jaw and heave to pry it away.

name: Tempered Loft
description: Hard qi at the tip lets the cast punch through a breastplate at close range.

name: Facetdart
description: Lean on the shaft and feed qi steadily until the point works through a thick hide.

name: Remnant Leadknob
description: Read the pulse of a beast's own qi to tell when it will charge.

name: Successive Dropdive
description: Throw one shaft at a seam to open it and a second into the opening at once.

name: Glint Dart
description: Throw into the shoulder of a rampaging beast to pin it where it stands and halt its charge.

name: Granite Dartcap
description: Hold one javelin forward and the other back so that each hand guards a separate side.

name: Dartassault
description: Throw one shaft high and the next low in quick turn so the foe can guard only one.

name: Whipping Throwloop
description: Slide in a long curve like a bending river to come round the edge of a guard.

name: Plumetorment
description: Cross both points in a scissoring thrust aimed at the throat and the hip together.

name: Blaze Whistle
description: Cast one shaft in a rising arc so that it falls into the space the second has cleared.

name: Murk Tailweight
description: Spread both shafts like wings to part two blows and turn them aside.

name: Silencing Dartpoint
description: Pass the second javelin into the lead hand as the first lands and keep the pressure unbroken.

name: Wrecking Loft
description: Throw both shafts on different lines that meet at a single point on the target.

name: Slag Skewerflight
description: Loose both shafts so that they spread like river water at its mouth across the front of the foe.

name: Barbedelixir
description: Hold still on a high perch and scan the ground below until a mark steps into range.

name: Barbedassault
description: Fold the shoulder tight and fall into the throw as a hawk folds its wings.

name: Staunch Leadknob
description: Grip the shaft like a talon so that a blow to the haft cannot tear it away.

name: Plumepounce
description: Drop from a ledge after the cast and land in a crouch ready for the next shaft.

name: Severing Launch
description: Throw from a height and run qi down the shaft so the point drops like a diving hawk.

name: Soaring Dart
description: Spread the cloak on a drop from height to slow the fall and land beside the target.

name: Transfixing Dartcap
description: Pull the shaft from the shoulder in one stoop and drive it into the mark with a talon's force.

name: Funneling Launch
description: Circle overhead to the mark's blind side and drop through a feint and a throw in one flight.

name: Plumecloak
description: Stand with the point held for the near track and the throwing arm drawn for the far.

name: Vaulting Whistle
description: Circle the foe at an even pace as water runs round the rim of a basin.

name: Launchthrash
description: Cast overhand along the far track while the free hand keeps the second shaft ready.

name: Harrowing Dartcap
description: Jab with the rear hand along the near track the moment the foe closes.

name: Murk Barbed
description: Slip the shaft through a foe's guard like a hand parting reeds on a riverbank.

name: Waning Thinheft
description: Count two beats at once with one for the throw and one for the thrust and keep them even.

name: Reverie Whistle
description: Swap from the near track to the far in mid-move to deceive the foe's reading of the range.

name: Trouncing Launch
description: Follow a strike with a cast that runs along the same line like one river current.

name: Vital Pointbalance
description: Store qi in the chest like water in a basin and release it into the arm in one pulse.

name: Mantled Thinheft
description: Cross two javelins in an X that catches a blade and locks it for a moment.

name: Tiered Throwloop
description: Strike on the near track and throw on the far and then close in on the answering guard.

name: Ravaging Gust Launch
description: Skim the shaft low and level over the ground and let it rise at the last moment into the chest.

name: Verity Fletch
description: Face the open plateau and take a bearing on the mark along the lead shoulder.

name: Plumebarrage
description: Read the wind on the cheek and throw to the side it will push the shaft.

name: Loftthrash
description: Throw from the lip of a drop where the ground gives the thrower height and reach.

name: Barbedplating
description: Stand as one who has sworn to give no ground and brace the shaft across the body.

name: Launchjaunt
description: Step into a sudden gust to keep the body in line with the mark.

name: Lancing Leadknob
description: Hold qi along the bearing from hand to mark so the shaft keeps its line through the wind.

name: Rumble Dart
description: Release into a crosswind and let qi bend the flight back onto the mark.

name: Gust Lightshaft
description: Turn the shaft in the wind's own sweep to part a blow and slide it harmlessly wide.

name: Nova Dropdive
description: Throw on a sworn straight line that no wind can bend and drive the point home.

name: Downpour Whistle
description: Sweep the shaft along the plateau's edge and throw a rolling gale of qi that drives back all in front.

name: Hardened Dartpoint
description: Hold the line on open ground with the shaft angled forward past the shoulder of the next thrower.

name: Fletchbarrage
description: Throw on the call of the line so that every shaft leaves in a single breath.

name: Blurring Launch
description: Walk the line at a measured pace to keep the sworn distance from the next thrower.

name: Fletchspurt
description: Give ground along the plateau's lip one step at a time and never turn the back.

name: Scorching Loft
description: Throw past the shield side of a comrade and let qi hold the shaft clear of the guard.

name: Daybreak Leadknob
description: Strike the butt on the ground and send a pulse of qi that steadies the neighbouring throwers.

name: Unmaking Nova Dart
description: Throw in a rolling order so that one shaft is always in the air as the next is drawn.

name: Alternating Whistle
description: Plant the oath stance and spend every shaft in a final run of throws before closing with the point.

name: Leadplating
description: Take a wide stance under open sky with the point forward and no cover to rely on.

name: Darttorment
description: Lean the shoulder into the wind and let its push add length to the throw.

name: Chime Pointbalance
description: Glance at a far peak or a cloud edge to fix the bearing of the throw.

name: Bounding Dartcap
description: Run the plateau in long strides that eat distance and keep the body low to the wind.

name: Gust Skewerflight
description: Release into a gale with qi along the shaft so that it rides the wind far past its usual reach.

name: Verity Tailweight
description: Hold the bearing by feel through a storm when the mark cannot be seen.

name: Resilient Throwloop
description: Whirl the shaft to catch the gale and push away missiles flying toward the body.

name: Needling Dropdive
description: Sworn qi and the wind together drive the shaft through a guard and the plate behind it.

name: Intertwined Launch
description: Run and throw and drop and run again in one unbroken pattern that leaves no fixed place to be struck.
